import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic
#check_failure MvPolynomial.degreeOf_taylor_le
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_add_le
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_prod_le
#check @MvPolynomial.degreeOf_pow_le
#check @MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le
#print MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le
#check @Polynomial.natDegree_taylor
noncomputable section
namespace MvPolynomial.DegreeTaylorRaw
variable {σ R : Type*} [CommSemiring R]
def shift (α : σ → R) : MvPolynomial σ R →ₐ[R] MvPolynomial σ R :=
  aeval fun j ↦ X j + C (α j)
theorem coefficientCriterion (Q : MvPolynomial σ R) (j : σ) (n : ℕ)
    (h : ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, n < d j → Q.coeff d = 0) : degreeOf j Q ≤ n :=
  degreeOf_le_iff.mpr fun d hd ↦ not_lt.mp fun hlt ↦
    (mem_support_iff.mp hd) (h d hlt)
theorem shiftCriterion (α : σ → R) (j : σ) (P : MvPolynomial σ R)
    (h : ∀ d : σ →₀ ℕ, degreeOf j P < d j → (shift α P).coeff d = 0) :
    degreeOf j (shift α P) ≤ degreeOf j P :=
  coefficientCriterion (shift α P) j (degreeOf j P) h
example (Q : Polynomial R) (r : R) : (Polynomial.taylor r Q).natDegree = Q.natDegree :=
  Polynomial.natDegree_taylor Q r
#print axioms coefficientCriterion
#print axioms shiftCriterion
end MvPolynomial.DegreeTaylorRaw

@MvPolynomial.degreeOf_le_iff : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {n : σ} {f : MvPolynomial σ R}
  {d : ℕ}, MvPolynomial.degreeOf n f ≤ d ↔ ∀ m ∈ f.support, m n ≤ d

@MvPolynomial.degreeOf_pow_le : ∀ {R : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] (i : σ) (p : MvPolynomial σ R)
  (n : ℕ), MvPolynomial.degreeOf i (p ^ n) ≤ n * MvPolynomial.degreeOf i p

theorem MvPolynomial.aeval_natDegree_le.{v, u_2} : ∀ {σ : Type v} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] {m n : ℕ}
  (F : MvPolynomial σ R),
  F.totalDegree ≤ m →
    ∀ (f : σ → Polynomial R), (∀ (i : σ), (f i).natDegree ≤ n) → ((MvPolynomial.aeval f) F).natDegree ≤ m * n :=
fun {σ} {R} [CommSemiring R] {m n} F hF f hf ↦
  Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.natDegree ≤ m * n) (MvPolynomial.aeval_def f F)))
    (Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a.natDegree ≤ m * n) (MvPolynomial.eval₂.eq_1 (algebraMap R (Polynomial R)) f F)))
      (LE.le.trans
        (Polynomial.natDegree_sum_le F.coeff.support fun i ↦
          (fun s a ↦ (algebraMap R (Polynomial R)) a * s.prod fun n e ↦ f n ^ e) i (F.coeff i))
        (Finset.sup_le fun d hd ↦
          id
            (id
              (id
                (LE.le.trans (Polynomial.natDegree_C_mul_le (F.coeff d) (d.prod fun n e ↦ f n ^ e))
                  (LE.le.trans (Polynomial.natDegree_prod_le d.support fun i ↦ (fun n e ↦ f n ^ e) i (d i))
                    (have this :=
                      Eq.mpr (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ _a ≤ m * n) (Eq.symm (Finset.sum_mul d.support (⇑d) n))))
                        (mul_le_mul'
                          (LE.le.trans
                            (Eq.mpr
                              (id (congrArg (fun _a ↦ ∑ i ∈ d.support, d i ≤ _a) (MvPolynomial.totalDegree.eq_1 F)))
                              (Finset.le_sup_of_le hd le_rfl))
                            hF)
                          le_rfl);
                    LE.le.trans
                      (Finset.sum_le_sum fun i a ↦ LE.le.trans Polynomial.natDegree_pow_le (mul_le_mul' le_rfl (hf i)))
                      this))))))))

@Polynomial.natDegree_taylor : ∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R) (r : R),
  ((Polynomial.taylor r) p).natDegree = p.natDegree
